title: fuzz finding (desync): at the first Cmd-N of a fresh launch, the app's own world check (debug.desync) checks every window (none unsettled) and finds no G1, W1 or W4
why: Action fuzz, layout set, 2026-10-31T08:xxZ (STATUS items 1002, 1022): after each Cmd-N, G1 'page window (618, 268, 892, 692) covers no pane' (x11 on feat-tip-fixes-v2, job f2f3083bac80ab71101d03ac; x10 on v2.2.10-opt, job 2efedfc30af35b895f12b6fe; cmux20). At the first Cmd-N of a launch, W1 'appkit content:pane_* (PageWebView) != model agentPage' and W4 'chromium page nil != model tab_*' (v2.2.10-opt, v2.2.11-opt 78ca62c225bb0943594e3cd2). W1/W4 need the app to be inactive while the cold New Tab page's Chromium page attaches; on feat builds the app's window becomes key in the slot, so W1/W4 do not occur there and only G1 makes this journey red on the feat base. The fix is #29272. first_in_app + fresh_app: only the first Cmd-N of a launch starts a cold New Tab page (an earlier journey in the lease would start Chromium and could hide W1/W4). check.unsettled must be empty: debug.desync skips W1-W4 for an unsettled window. The rpc steps keep debug.desync, debug.focus and debug.layers in result.json as evidence.
source: scripts/journeys/fuzz.py (ext_fuzz) recorded findings, not shrunk (one action); review of #29274 (FIX at 6e1b67e71e0)
